requirements.text: A simple online booking system that allows customers to choose a service, barber, and appointment time
Services will include options like classic cuts, fades, and beard trims
Customers will have the option to select a specific barber or book with whoever is available
The system will reflect the barbers' availability to prevent double bookings
The solution should be easy to use for both customers and staff, while also being budget-conscious
Customers should be able to cancel or change their appointments online without needing to call the shop
